name: geomeasure
description: Geospatial file measurement platform — one command to run backend + frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env EMBEDDED_WORKER=true python -m uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --reload --app-dir backend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend ci && pip install -c backend/constraints.txt -e "./backend[dev]"
